title: Report a retailer breaking tobacco/e-cigarette retailing laws
summary: This page provides information on how to report a retailer in NSW that is breaking tobacco or e-cigarette retailing laws.
intro:
Tobacco retailing laws regulate the packaging, advertising, display and sale of tobacco products, non-tobacco smoking products and e-cigarettes and accessories in NSW.

If you think a tobacco or e-cigarette retailing law has been broken by a retailer in NSW, you can report it.
